summary: Verified new EmployeeDeleteDialog + stacked management layout. Backend 53/54 tests pass (1 pre-existing unrelated quick-vendor address assertion). UI: admin login → confirmed Vendor Management (top: 2881) is above Field Employees (top: 4042) with .management-grid using single column; created TEST_DelUI_XXXXXX employee, opened delete dialog (name shown), Cancel closes without deleting, employee still present. Simulated stale-row error: server-deleted employee → clicking Confirm shows in-dialog error 'Employee not found' (data-testid=employee-delete-error) instead of silent failure. Created a second temp employee, confirmed delete → dialog closes, sonner toast 'TEST_DelUI2_XXXXXX was removed', row removed from listing, and login attempt returns 401 (auth cascade works). Employee-role blocked from DELETE /api/employees/{id} (backend test test_employee_blocked_from_delete_employee passes with 403). Admin reset-password + activity endpoints still functional (backend tests pass). Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow. No console errors other than expected 401 for pre-login and error-simulation.

minor.issue: Vendor returned by quick-add has empty phone/address; test test_employee_quick_add_creates_vendor asserts truthy 'address' — pre-existing (also flagged in iteration_8). Either backfill placeholder or relax test.

action_items: (Optional/pre-existing) Fix quick-vendor placeholder phone/address OR relax assertion in test_employee_quick_add_creates_vendor (backend_test.py:496).
critical_code_review_comments: EmployeeDeleteDialog.jsx correctly surfaces requestError.response?.data?.detail; falls back to a generic message — good UX.
Delete cascade in router.remove_employee removes employees + users + soft-deletes files; collections history retained by design.
management-grid CSS now single-column globally (grid-template-columns: 1fr) — vendor+field-employees always stacked vertically on all breakpoints (matches user requirement).

AdminPortal.jsx is a very long single-line JSX file (readability/maintainability concern); consider reformatting/splitting into subcomponents (VendorManagement, FieldEmployees, EmployeeRow) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted two transient employees TEST_DelUI_XXXXXX and TEST_DelUI2_XXXXXX via admin UI (both removed via UI flow). No seeded accounts touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delete flow selectors: delete-employee-{id}, employee-delete-dialog, cancel-employee-delete-button, confirm-employee-delete-button, close-employee-delete-button, employee-delete-error, employee-delete-message. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover admin delete cascade (TestAdminDeleteEmployee) and employee 403 (test_employee_blocked_from_delete_employee).
rca of the issue: Original bug: window.confirm-based flow was reportedly unreliable in preview. Replaced with dedicated EmployeeDeleteDialog surfacing loading/success/error states and toast. Confirmed working end-to-end (cancel, success, and error paths).
